recipe.name: Dev Aliases (zsh)
recipe.description: Useful zsh aliases for Node, Vercel, ports, utilities, and ffmpeg helpers.

steps.title: Append aliases to ~/.zshrc
steps.command:
bash -lc "cat >> ~/.zshrc <<'ALIAS'
# AgentKit Dev Aliases
# Node / package managers
alias ni='npm install'
alias nid='npm install --save-dev'
alias nr='npm run'
alias nrd='npm run dev'
alias nrb='npm run build'
alias nrs='npm run start'

# Vercel
alias vp='npx vercel --prod --yes'
alias vd='npx vercel'
alias vl='vercel logs'

# Local dev helpers
alias psg='ps aux | grep -i'
alias ports='lsof -i -P | grep LISTEN'
alias kill3000='lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9'
alias kill3001='lsof -ti:3001 | xargs kill -9'
alias kill5000='lsof -ti:5000 | xargs kill -9'

# Quick project serving
alias serve='python3 -m http.server'

# Common directories (edit to match your machine)
alias dev='cd ~/dev'
alias projects='cd ~/projects'
alias oc='cd ~/.openclaw/workspace/projects'

# Utilities
alias zshreload='source ~/.zshrc'
alias myip='curl ifconfig.me'
alias flushdns='sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder'

ALIAS"

steps.title: Reminder
steps.description: Open a new terminal or run `source ~/.zshrc` to load the new aliases.
